content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ASTC Manager (Finance) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Assam State Transport Corporation (ASTC) for various posts. It is a government job opportunity in Assam.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for which this recruitment is being conducted?
faq.answer: This recruitment drive is for the post of Manager (Finance). Interested candidates should check the eligibility criteria carefully.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Manager (Finance) post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Manager (Finance) post in the Assam State Transport Corporation (ASTC) recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for ASTC Manager (Finance) recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Manager (Finance) post is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly on the specified date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for the Manager (Finance) post?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Manager (Finance) post must have a Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification from a recognized Institute.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Manager (Finance) post in ASTC?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Manager (Finance) post is 30 years. Age relaxation may apply as per government rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Manager (Finance) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Manager (Finance) post will receive a salary of Rs. 65,000.00 Per Month. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q8. What are the important dates for the ASTC Manager (Finance) Walk-in Interview 2026?
faq.answer: The application start date is 07 August 2026, the last date for application submission is 14 August 2026, and the walk-in interview date is 20 August 2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Manager (Finance) post at ASTC?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Manager (Finance) post primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be assessed based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for the ASTC Manager (Finance) recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Manager (Finance) recruitment. The fee is Nil.
